name: Beside ~Shiawase wa Katawara ni~
source:
When I was young, I fell in love.
I loved her from a very early age, and she was like a big sister to me. Her mother died when she was little, and her father was always working.
But, she went to college, and had to move.
I confessed my feelings to her, but the train's noise took her answer away with the wind.

A few years later, I went to university, and forgot the events that happened then. I had trouble finding a job, and my brother got married and moved to Hawaii, so I decided to go back to my parents' house.
However, there was something I didn't expect...

To meet with her again, under the same sky, while she smiled as always.

[based on [url=http://www.dreamsoft.jp/beside/beside_story01.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
年少时，我坠入了爱河。
我从很小的时候便喜欢着她，她对我而言就像姐姐一样。她幼年丧母，父亲又总是忙于工作。
后来，她考上大学，不得不搬走。
我向她倾诉了心意，可列车的轰鸣将她的回答卷入风中。

几年后，我也进入大学，渐渐淡忘了当年的往事。求职屡屡受挫，哥哥又在结婚后搬去了夏威夷，于是我决定回到父母家。
然而，那里有一件我未曾料到的事……

我会在同一片天空下与她重逢，而她仍像从前一样微笑着。

[根据[url=http://www.dreamsoft.jp/beside/beside_story01.html]官方网站[/url]]
